name: Member's Mark Cocktail Beef Meatballs with Sweet Chili Sauce (Warning)
whyItWorks: Pre-cooked beef and pork meatballs packed with granulated onion, garlic powder, and glazed with spicy sweet chili pepper sauce. Concentrated alliums and chili seeds provoke gastric reflux and mucosal cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Allium & Chili Warning: Avoid during flares. In remission, rinse off sweet chili glaze or eat plain meatballs.
